name: Geneinno T1 Pro
description: A tethered, six-thruster underwater ROV from Shenzhen Geneinno Technology, positioned above consumer photography drones and into light-industrial territory — hull and pier inspection, aquaculture monitoring, search and recovery, and underwater filming, alongside recreational use. Rated to 175m depth with a real accessory ecosystem (gripper arm, external camera, 360° scanning sonar, water-quality sensor), putting it closer in market position to Chasing's M2-series than to Chasing's consumer Dory or Gladius Mini S.

specs.label: Battery
specs.note: 4 hrs standard, up to 8 hrs with optional external battery pack; ~3 hr charge

specs.label: Weight
specs.note: retailer-sourced figure, not manufacturer-confirmed; full package with case/accessories runs ~32.5 lbs

specs.label: Camera
specs.note: 1/2.3" CMOS, f/2.5, 160° FOV, no zoom despite "Pro" branding; 1080p live preview feed

specs.label: Depth Rating
specs.note: a retailer listing this as "200m depth" is conflating it with the optional 200m tether length — confirmed 175m on the manufacturer spec sheet

specs.label: Thrusters
specs.note: optional add-on lateral thruster module available for extra sideways control

specs.label: Tether
specs.note: tethers to a floating wireless relay buoy; buoy talks to the tablet controller wirelessly

specs.label: Control
specs.note: Bluetooth game-style controller supported for "professional operation"; no confirmed HDMI output

specs.label: Storage
specs.note: fixed, no expansion slot found in any spec sheet

specs.label: Accessories
specs.note: 360° "Omni Scan Sonar," water-quality sensor, laser scaler — a real modular ecosystem, not just cosmetic add-ons

specs.label: Subscription
specs.note: Geneinno app (iOS/Android) lists no in-app purchases or paid tiers; no cloud video storage or editing subscription identified for T1 Pro

sourcing: Specs compiled from Geneinno's official user manual PDF, B&H Photo's product listings, and launch coverage from New Atlas and DeeperBlue. Flagged as unconfirmed or conflicting above: current MSRP (wide spread across retailers), the LA-vs-Shenzhen headquarters discrepancy, several accessory prices sourced from a single retailer, whether the internal battery is user-swappable, and whether reliability complaints found for the base T1 carry over to the T1 Pro's current hardware revision. The "Geneinno Point" product line and any DJI partnership were investigated and found to be unsupported by any source — both excluded from this page. This entry hasn't yet been cross-linked or synced to the directory listing; that's planned for a later pass.

pricing.summary: The T1 Pro launched around **$2,999** in 2020, but current retail pricing is scattered rather than settled on one figure, realistically ranging from about $2,200 to $3,300 depending on tether length and bundle. A $4,099 listing at B&H Photo is flagged there as a low-stock special order and looks like an outlier rather than typical pricing.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: There is no Geneinno "Point" product line despite claims sometimes made about this brand — the real lineup is Poseidon, Titan/T1, T1 Pro, and the separate S1-series sea scooters. There is also no DJI–Geneinno partnership or DJI underwater drone; the only DJI connection found in any source is an analyst's loose market comparison, not an actual corporate relationship.

firmwareCommunity.note: Geneinno T1 Pro has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
